agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL
  BUDGET STUDY SESSION AGENDA
  June 3, 2026 – 6:00 P.M.
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  5938 KAUFFMAN AVENUE - TEMPLE CITY

PROCEDURE TO ADDRESS CITY COUNCIL:

In person: Members of the Public who wish to address the City Council may do so by completing a
Speaker Request Form, indicating the agenda item number and submitting it to the City Clerk.
Unless waived by Council, t here is a 3-minute time limit on each speaker with a maximum period
of 30 minutes for comments on any subject.

Written Comment: Written public comments received by 5pm on the day of the meeting will be
provided to the City Council and made part of the meeting record. Written public comments will not be
read aloud by city staff or City Council.

You have the opportunity to address the City Council at the following times:

  •  Agenda item: at the time the Council considers the agenda item;
  •  Non-agenda item: at the time for PUBLIC COMMENTS. Please note that while the City
  Council values your comments, pursuant to the Brown Act, the Council cannot take action
  on any item not listed on the agenda; and
  •  Public Hearing: at the time for public hearings under PUBLIC HEARING.

The listing of any item on the agenda includes the authority of the Council to take action on
such item and to approve, disapprove, or give directions on any item.

NOTICE: Staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business of this
Agenda are available for viewing on the City’s website at templecityca.gov and are on file and
available for review during regular office hours in the Office of the City Clerk located at City Hall,
9701 Las Tunas Drive, Temple City, California. Written documentation submitted to the City
Council after distribution of the agenda packet can be obtained at the City Clerk’s Office during
regular office hours.

ACCESSIBILITY: In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special
assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the City Clerk at (626) 285-2171.
Notification 72 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements
to ensure accessibility to this meeting.

TO WATCH REGULAR MEETINGS LIVE OR RECORDED, VISIT:
https://www.youtube.com/@ConnectWithTC

AGENDA NOTIFICATION SUBSCRIPTION:
If you wish to receive an agenda email notification, please email your request to
cityclerk@templecityca.gov or call (626) 285-2171.
  City Council Budget Study Session Agenda
 June 3, 2026
 Page 2 of 2

 1. CALL TO ORDER – Mayor Man

 2. ROLL CALL – Councilmember Chavez, Sternquist, Yu, Chen, Man

 3. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS NOT LISTED ON THE AGENDA

  The City Council will now hear public comments regarding items not listed on the
  agenda. The procedure to address the City Council is highlighted on the first page
  of this agenda. This section is limited to 30 minutes total.

 4. NEW BUSINESS

  A. FISCAL YEAR 2026-2027 PROPOSED ANNUAL BUDGET
  The City Council is requested to review the proposed city budget and the Schedule
  of Fees and Fines for Fiscal Year 2026-2027 and provide staff directions.

  Presenter:  Administrative Services Director

  Recommendation:

  1. Proposed Budget for Fiscal Year 2026-2027 (“FY26-27”) in Attachment “A”; and

  2. Proposed Schedule of Fees and Fines for FY26-27 in Attachment “B”.

  Attachment:  Staff Report

5.  ADJOURNMENT
